vis.scope: Input MS or CalTable (blank for none)

xdatacolumn.scope: Use a stored MeasurementSet visibility column or an unaveraged vector or scalar residual or model ratio for X independently of Y. Unaveraged real and signed amplitude axes can use FLOAT_DATA. A blank selector uses observed data for a new plot. Selected virtual models supply unaveraged model coordinates without materializing a MODEL_DATA column. Complex inputs without a stored or applicable virtual model use the default visibility model. Additional column forms remain open. Channel and ordinary vector time averaging support separately weighted stored visibility columns.

xframe.scope: Coordinate frame to use for x-axis

yaxis.scope: Plot a single ordinate or a list. Unaveraged MeasurementSet visibility lists can contain more than two independent ordinates.

ydatacolumn.scope: Use a stored MeasurementSet visibility column or an unaveraged vector or scalar residual or model ratio for Y independently of X. Unaveraged real and signed amplitude axes can use FLOAT_DATA. Unaveraged visibility ordinates and up to two channel-averaged ordinates can choose independent stored columns, including ordinates of the same axis type. Missing column list entries use observed data. Selected virtual models supply unaveraged model coordinates without materializing a MODEL_DATA column. Complex inputs without a stored or applicable virtual model use the default visibility model. Additional column forms and mixed visibility and metadata ordinate lists remain open. Channel and ordinary vector time averaging support separately weighted stored visibility columns.

yframe.scope: Coordinate frame to use for y-axis

yaxislocation.scope: Choose the left or right side. PlotMS groups more than two unaveraged MeasurementSet visibility ordinates by side. An omitted position defaults to left. A scalar location does not apply to an ordinate list.

field.scope: Field names or ids (blank for all)

uvrange.scope: UV range (blank for all). Modern calibration tables reject this selector.

antenna.scope: Baseline/antenna names or ids (blank for all)

antpos.scope: Display XYZ components of an antenna-position calibration, or select an ordered component subset. Preserve the requested selector in text metadata for other calibration types.

array.scope: (Sub)array numbers (blank for all). Modern calibration tables reject this selector.

intent.scope: Observing intent (blank for all). Modern calibration tables reject this selector.

feed.scope: Feed numbers (blank for all). Modern calibration tables reject this selector.

msselect.scope: Apply a TaQL row expression to a modern calibration table. Refuse a selection with no solutions.

avgchannel.scope: Average selected channels into bins. MeasurementSet data, corrected and stored model axes use the corresponding spectral weights when available, including two independent ordinates. Channel averaging composes with ordinary vector time averaging. Vector baseline averaging can follow channel averaging at each integration.

avgtime.scope: Average selected samples over the requested interval in seconds. Ordinary MeasurementSet vector time averaging can use two independent stored ordinate columns with a visibility, time, channel or frequency abscissa. Channel and time averaging can be combined for those axes.

avgscan.scope: Permit time bins to cross scan boundaries. For two independent MeasurementSet visibility ordinates, vector averaging keeps the requested grouping and uses the first chronological integration for the bin metadata.

avgfield.scope: Permit time bins to cross field boundaries. For two independent MeasurementSet visibility ordinates, vector averaging keeps the requested grouping and uses the first chronological integration for the bin metadata.

avgbaseline.scope: Vector-average selected baselines within each integration for stored MeasurementSet visibility axes. Use the scalar weight of the first selected correlation for all plotted visibility columns. Vector baseline averaging can follow channel averaging at each integration.

avgantenna.scope: Average per antenna (mutually exclusive with avgbaseline)

scalar.scope: Scalar averaging (False=vector averaging) Ordinary MeasurementSet channel-only averaging uses vector visibilities, and the text header retains the requested scalar control.

transform.scope: Disable the frequency controls when false. Additional active calibration transforms remain open.

freqframe.scope: Calibration-table PlotMS retains the table’s stored spectral coordinates and warns when an active frame is requested. MeasurementSet transform coverage is tracked separately.

restfreq.scope: CASA leaves modern calibration-table coordinates unchanged for supplied rest-frequency values. Frequency and velocity transforms for other inputs remain separately tracked.

veldef.scope: The definition in which to render velocity

phasecenter.scope: The direction coordinates of the desired center

extendflag.scope: Extend flagging to other data points not plotted

iteraxis.scope: The axis over which to iterate

xselfscale.scope: When True, iterated plots have a common x-axis range (scale).

yselfscale.scope: When True, iterated plots have a common y-axis range (scale).

xsharedaxis.scope: Iterated plots on a grid share a common external x-axis per column. Must also set xselfscale=True and gridrows>1.

ysharedaxis.scope: Iterated plots on a grid share a common external y-axis per row. Must also set yselfscale=True and gridcols>1.

customsymbol.scope: Enable custom symbol(s) for unflagged points

symbolcolor.scope: Color (name or hex code) of plotted unflagged symbols

symbolfill.scope: Fill type of plotted unflagged symbols

customflaggedsymbol.scope: Enable custom symbols for flagged calibration solutions. Visible flagged points with independent stored MeasurementSet columns are refused under #1032.

flaggedsymbolcolor.scope: Color (name or hex code) of plotted flagged symbols

flaggedsymbolfill.scope: Fill type of plotted flagged symbols

timeconnector.scope: Connect points by time rather than x-axis

xlabel.scope: Text for horizontal x-axis. Blank for default.

ylabel.scope: Text for vertical y-axis. Blank for default.

majorwidth.scope: Line width in pixels of major grid lines

majorcolor.scope: Color (name or hex code) of major grid lines

minorwidth.scope: Line width in pixels of minor grid lines

minorcolor.scope: Color (name or hex code) of minor grid lines

showlegend.scope: Show a legend on the plot.

plotfile.scope: Name of plot file to save automatically

expformat.scope: Export format type. If not provided, plotfile extension will be used to determine type.

exprange.scope: Range of iteration plots to export, one plotfile per page. Multipage pdf exports are not supported.

width.scope: Width in pixels of exported plot

height.scope: Height in pixels of exported plot

overwrite.scope: Overwrite plot file if it already exists

clearplots.scope: Remove any existing plots so new ones can replace them.

callib.scope: Apply ordered file or inline callibraries while reading selected MeasurementSet rows. Export text or a single figure with transient corrected data, flags and recalculated scalar or spectral weights. Iterated figures and additional calibration plotting controls remain open.

headeritems.scope: Render requested page headers and metadata on current calibration tables and supported MeasurementSet figures. Shared MeasurementSet figure coverage is tracked separately.

showatm.scope: Overlay atmospheric transmission on MeasurementSets and current calibration tables.

showtsky.scope: Overlay sky temperature on MeasurementSets and current calibration tables.

showimage.scope: Overlay a receiver image sideband on MeasurementSets and current calibration tables.

colorizeoverlay.scope: Color atmospheric overlays by the selected metadata axis in MeasurementSet and calibration-table figures.

behaviors.title: Read MeasurementSets and calibration tables
behaviors.scope: Open casacore MeasurementSets and current, BPOLY and GSPLINE calibration tables through vis or caltable, preserving the public None return and input-path checks.
behaviors.gap: Remaining MeasurementSet plotting paths are open under #1032 and #215.

behaviors.title: Select solution samples
behaviors.scope: Select solution rows and channels by field, window, time, antenna, scan, observation, polarization, antenna-position component and TaQL. Refuse unsupported modern calibration selectors. Resolve GSPLINE selection directly against source table rows and CAL_DESC. Route ordinary MeasurementSet visibility plots through native row, baseline, channel, correlation and flag selection.
behaviors.gap: Remaining MeasurementSet selection paths are open under #1032 and #215.

behaviors.title: Project axes and flags
behaviors.scope: Read complex and real parameter cells and select calibration axes. Keep flagged sample visibility consistent in text and image products. Validate active axis and range controls before writing. Use the reference axes for Tsys and antenna-position products. Evaluate stored BPOLY and GSPLINE coefficients and expose their solution flags and metadata. Plot independent stored MeasurementSet DATA, CORRECTED_DATA and MODEL_DATA axes and unaveraged vector and scalar residuals or model ratios with the shared sample mask. Use DATA for corrected axes, residuals and ratios when the stored corrected column is absent on a complex MeasurementSet. Use FLOAT_DATA for observed visibilities on unaveraged mixed inputs and signed amplitude or real axes on float-only inputs. Keep the requested order and column identity for independent unaveraged visibility ordinates and group them by figure side. Use the default visibility model for complex data without a stored model or an applicable virtual recipe. Predict selected virtual component and Fourier models through the native visibility model engine.
behaviors.gap: Pointing-coordinate axes, mixed visibility and metadata ordinate masks, additional averaging modes and additional MS column forms are open.

behaviors.title: Average selected plot samples
behaviors.scope: Average calibration solutions in weighted channel and time bins with scan, field, antenna, baseline and spectral-window controls. Keep flagged channel frequency coordinates consistent with the CASA cache. For MeasurementSets, independently channel-average stored visibility columns while applying each column's spectral weights and the selected channel flags. Ordinary vector time averaging uses the selected integrations, per-column weights and the MeasurementSet transform time groups. Channel averaging can follow ordinary vector time averaging. The primary channel weights determine which averaged bins render. Vector time bins can span the requested scan and field boundaries. Vector baseline averages use the visibility iterator order and preserve separate observations. Text exports use synthetic antenna IDs. For combined channel and baseline averages, each visibility column is averaged across channels before the baseline reducer applies the transformed scalar weight.
behaviors.gap: Combined baseline and time cases, scalar, antenna and spectral-window averaging, fully masked exports, effective FLOAT_DATA and derived visibility averages, and additional flagged and weight coordinates remain under #1032.

behaviors.title: Lay out and export calibration pages
behaviors.scope: Partition selected series across a grid. Text reports the current page. Image export provides current and all-page ranges and names the physical outputs in successful completions.
behaviors.gap: Explicit plot placement, persistent pages and additional presentation modes are open.

behaviors.title: Render the shared plot document
behaviors.scope: Transfer native arrays through the existing binary payload and draw them in the shared Matplotlib renderer. Apply plot titles, labels, marker size and shape, connectors, grids, legend, page headers and export sizing.
behaviors.gap: Renderer-specific marker fill patterns and interactive editing remain open.

behaviors.title: Save and publish selected plot products
behaviors.scope: Write current and legacy calibration coordinates and metadata as text and render figures through the shared Python presenter. Publish requested files and preserve existing files when overwrite is false. Export ordinary MeasurementSet visibility coordinates and independent stored visibility columns as text and figures. Export calibrated MeasurementSet text and paginated figures, including atmospheric curves.
behaviors.gap: More export, multi-plot state and interactive display forms remain open.

behaviors.title: Advanced calibration plotting controls
behaviors.scope: Apply calibration libraries to MeasurementSet plots in memory. Compute transmission, sky temperature and receiver sidebands for MeasurementSets and calibration tables, including selected channels and requested overlay color groups.
behaviors.gap: Remaining shared PlotMS forms are tracked in #1032 and #215.

decisions.inputs: A PlotMS request with selectdata=False and supplied selection text.
decisions.casa: Raises Exception with message updateImmediately must be a boolean.
decisions.ours: Displays and exports all available solution points without applying the selector text.
decisions.rationale: Make the documented selection switch work when it is false.
decisions.impact: The native request produces all 160 available points in the paired fixture. The same fallback preserves all 1,920 points in the unfiltered callibrary case.
decisions.record: PlotMS disabling selection calls the selection setter with a missing argument

decisions.inputs: Modern calibration input with an unsupported selector, invalid antenna-position selector or empty TaQL selection.
decisions.casa: Refuses the plot with an RPC failure whose details say plot parameters failed.
decisions.ours: Refuses the plot with a task parameter error describing the selector or empty row set.
decisions.rationale: Give the caller the cause using the native task error contract.
decisions.impact: Both workflows preserve an absent export on selection failure.

decisions.inputs: A five-antenna GSPLINE table plotted with antenna="!A2".
decisions.casa: Displays only antenna A2, despite negation.
decisions.ours: Displays A0, A1, A3 and A4.
decisions.rationale: Honor the documented antenna exclusion instead of passing the excluded ID to the plot cache.
decisions.impact: The displayed antenna membership follows the source-row filter.
decisions.record: PlotMS shows the excluded antenna on a GSPLINE plot

paired.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14 and casaplotms 2.9.1 public calls on identical current-format calibration tables.
paired.result: 38 text exports, 1,200 points, 14 exact errors, 32 rendered coordinates and scan, baseline and time page filenames matched.

remaining.scope: Shared PlotMS rendering, MeasurementSet workflows and interactive controls under #1032 and #215.
remaining.result: Requires additional native behavior and paired evidence.

atmosphere.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14 and casaplotms 2.9.1 on the same current-format bandpass and gain tables, with optional associated weather, water-vapour and receiver tables.
atmosphere.result: 21 exports, 985 selected coordinates, one Python axis error and 19 rendered coordinates matched. Seven wide-band, weather and receiver overlay cases had a maximum normalized RMS of 0.00012.

ms-atmosphere.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14 with casaplotms 2.9.1 on the same MeasurementSets and calibration tables, including measured weather, water vapour, receiver sidebands, averaging, scan iteration and read-only callibrary correction.
ms-atmosphere.result: Matched 17 exports and 4,540 printed coordinates and metadata. Six figure names and 400 rendered coordinates matched. Default visibility and atmosphere markers remained visible, and the scan and correlation colors had the expected group membership. Maximum overlay normalized RMS was 9.15099e-5. The input MeasurementSet data, weights and flags were preserved.

calibration-controls.kind: Same-input calibration-table PlotMS headers and transform controls
calibration-controls.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14 and casaplotms 2.9.1 on the same current bandpass table and selected calibration solutions. Public page headers and spectral transform settings.
calibration-controls.result: Three text exports matched byte for byte. CASA rendered the requested page header labels. Native verified stored table values, independent field pages, absent wildcard metadata, a polynomial direction and row-specific frame, and non-overlapping 1000 by 400 pixel headers at 100 and 300 DPI. Two native active transform calls preserved the reference coordinates after a warning. The pinned renderer failed to complete active frame requests on the test table.

selectors.kind: Same-input PlotMS calibration types and selectors
selectors.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14 with casaplotms 2.9.1 on identical modern calibration tables, including Tsys and antenna position.
selectors.result: 56 text exports, 1,688 points, 14 exact errors, six paired refusals and 32 rendered coordinates matched. Scan, baseline, time and antenna-position page exports used the same filenames.

callibrary.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14 and casaplotms 2.9.1 on identical MeasurementSets with file and inline callibraries, independent data columns and averaged channel and time coordinates.
callibrary.result: 43 public text exports, 874 points, one missing-library error and 12 rendered coordinates matched. The paired averages cover selected and strided channels and calibrated per-channel weights. Source visibilities, stored corrections, flags and weights were preserved. The disabled selector fallback matched 1,920 CASA points.

ms-columns.scope: Public Python tasks in CASA 6.7.6.14 with casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs on one identical MeasurementSet with stored DATA, CORRECTED_DATA and MODEL_DATA.
ms-columns.result: Four text exports matched 48 visible points with their source metadata, including independently defaulted axes. Two 500 by 360 pixel PNGs had 24 Matplotlib coordinates matching the CASA text exports, with column names and units in the default labels. Two unsupported mixed-column requests produced issue-linked refusals and no native outputs. The input data and flags remained unchanged.

ms-residual-columns.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs on a selected MeasurementSet with distinct stored DATA, CORRECTED_DATA and MODEL_DATA values.
ms-residual-columns.result: Six vector residual text exports matched 72 selected coordinate pairs and their metadata, including a residual against time and explicit zero averaging. A 500 by 360 pixel PNG matched 12 artist coordinates and displayed the CASA column labels and phase unit. The source data and flags remained unchanged.

ms-scalar-residual-columns.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs on the same unaveraged MeasurementSet plots of signed amplitude, phase and real and imaginary scalar residuals.
ms-scalar-residual-columns.result: Five paired text exports matched 60 selected points, metadata and headers, including a residual against time and fallback when CORRECTED_DATA was absent. Two 500 by 360 pixel PNGs matched 24 rendered coordinates, including phase residuals greater than 180 degrees, with CASA column labels and phase units. The source data and flags remained unchanged.

ms-model-ratios.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs on identical unaveraged MeasurementSet requests for explicit and implicit vector ratios and scalar ratios.
ms-model-ratios.result: Fourteen paired text exports matched 168 selected points, metadata and headers, including corrected fallback, zero models, and overflow and underflow at CASA's float precision. Three 500 by 360 pixel PNGs matched 36 artist coordinate pairs and default labels. Scalar amplitude divides magnitudes, scalar phase divides observed phase by model magnitude, and scalar real and imaginary ordinates subtract the model component as in CASA.

ms-ordinate-columns.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs on identical selected unaveraged MeasurementSet requests for two ordinate columns.
ms-ordinate-columns.result: Nine paired text exports matched 216 selected points with exact source metadata and requested ordinate order. Two 500 by 360 pixel PNGs matched both labeled artist layers and their 48 coordinates. Cases cover repeated axis types with different columns, short lists, an abscissa sharing a column, and missing CORRECTED_DATA. Both tasks refused six duplicate or malformed selections before writing any output.

ms-ordinary-visibility.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs on one MeasurementSet using default observed visibility columns, a named baseline, selected channels and correlation, and mixed flags.
ms-ordinary-visibility.result: Amplitude/phase, amplitude/channel and amplitude/time matched across three text exports with 36 coordinate pairs and exact source metadata. Three 500 by 360 pixel PNGs matched the artist data and axis labels. Exported and rendered times matched CASA text to its 1 ms precision.

ms-float-data.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs with unaveraged float-only and mixed float/complex MeasurementSets.
ms-float-data.result: Ten paired texts matched 120 selected points, including signed values, default and corrected fallback, channel ordinates, and independent complex axes on mixed input. Two 500 by 360 pixel PNGs matched 24 artist coordinates. The native real axis matched the reference signed-amplitude coordinates after the CASA real-axis backend closed its RPC connection. Both tasks refused an absent FLOAT_DATA column, an explicit phase request and two residual requests on float-plus-model storage without DATA. A mixed-input average is refused with a #1032 diagnostic while support remains open.

ms-corrected-fallback.scope: Selected complex MeasurementSet without CORRECTED_DATA. Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs use DATA for corrected plots and DATA minus MODEL_DATA for corrected vector residuals.
ms-corrected-fallback.result: Five paired text exports matched 60 points and their exact source metadata. One 500 by 360 pixel PNG matched 12 rendered coordinates and the effective default column labels. Neither task added the corrected column or changed the source data and flags.

legacy-calibration.scope: CASA 6.7.6.14 and casaplotms 2.9.1 on the same persisted BPOLY and GSPLINE tables with receptor-dependent gains, surviving and flagged receptors, and source-row selection.
legacy-calibration.result: 20 text exports, 31,696 points, exact headers and metadata, and 2,080 rendered coordinates matched. Maximum ordinate normalized RMS 3.78525e-07. Four invalid requests were refused by both engines. The negated-antenna diagnostic confirms the CASA bug and native selection behavior. The input tables and associated MeasurementSet were unchanged.

ms-default-model.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs on the same complex MeasurementSets without a stored MODEL_DATA column.
ms-default-model.result: Seven paired text exports matched 78 selected points and exact source metadata, including unit parallel hands, zero cross-hands, residuals, corrected-only storage, a dangling pointer and a virtual model in another spectral window. One 500 by 360 pixel PNG matched 12 artist coordinates, labels and dimensions. A selected virtual recipe still reports pending support in #1032.

ms-virtual-model.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs on the same unaveraged MeasurementSet requests with native prediction of virtual component and image models.
ms-virtual-model.result: Six paired text exports matched 48 selected points and their source metadata. A virtual component supplies 7.25 Jy and its residual; the matching virtual model has priority over stored MODEL_DATA, its unmodeled window uses the default, and an unrelated field uses stored values. A Fourier image matches both real and imaginary coordinates. One 500 by 360 pixel PNG matches six artist coordinates and axis labels. The source data, flags and stored model values were preserved.

ms-channel-columns.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs with independent stored visibility columns, selected channel bins and nonuniform spectral weights.
ms-channel-columns.result: Eleven paired text exports matched 228 averaged coordinates and their source metadata. Tests cover mixed flags, the separate DATA and CORRECTED_DATA weights, MODEL_DATA with and without additional columns, missing and undefined spectra, zero-weight bins, a shared abscissa column and an ignored scalar request. One 500 by 360 pixel PNG matched both ordinate layers and their 24 coordinates. Twelve additional model abscissa coordinates match with a weight ordinate.

ms-multiple-visibility-ordinates.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs for unaveraged MeasurementSet plots with three or four independent visibility ordinates.
ms-multiple-visibility-ordinates.result: Five paired text exports matched 246 selected coordinates and source metadata, including repeated axis kinds, short column lists, shared source cells and a virtual model used only on the third ordinate. Four 500 by 360 pixel PNGs matched left and right grouping, labels and 198 artist coordinates, including connector order with two correlations and scalar or short side settings. Both tasks refused duplicate ordinates and invalid side settings.

ms-time-columns.kind: Same-input vector time-averaged MeasurementSet visibility columns
ms-time-columns.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs with two independent stored visibility ordinates and ordinary vector time averaging on the same selected MeasurementSets.
ms-time-columns.result: Nineteen paired text exports match 118 selected coordinates and their source metadata. The cases cover inverse sigma squared and corrected weights, model weights with and without CORRECTED_DATA, per-channel spectra, zero weights, mixed flags, omitted all-flagged bins, singleton timestamps, scan boundaries, reverse-ordered physical rows and complex cancellation. One 500 by 360 pixel PNG matches both labeled layers and all six artist coordinates. Three cases verify the pending diagnostics for weighted U and virtual models.

ms-channel-time-columns.kind: Same-input channel and vector time-averaged MeasurementSet visibility columns
ms-channel-time-columns.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs with two independent stored visibility ordinates and combined channel and ordinary vector time averaging.
ms-channel-time-columns.result: Eight paired text exports match 54 selected coordinates and metadata. The tests cover nonuniform spectral weights, time-derived row weights, mixed flags, discarded incomplete channel bins and zero primary or secondary weights. One 500 by 360 pixel PNG matches both labeled layers and six artist coordinates. A fully masked result has an explicit pending diagnostic. Two additional cases cover 18 coordinates on a mixed FLOAT_DATA input. The native complex ordinate averages retain their unit input values and match the exported CASA bin metadata.

ms-scan-field-time-columns.kind: Same-input MeasurementSet vector time averaging across scans and fields
ms-scan-field-time-columns.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs with independent stored MeasurementSet visibility ordinates and vector time averaging across selected scans and fields.
ms-scan-field-time-columns.result: Twelve paired text exports match 34 coordinates, the time midpoint and the source scan and field. Cases cover each boundary alone, both boundaries together, retained boundaries, channel averaging, scan and field color grouping and reverse-ordered physical rows. Three 500 by 360 pixel PNGs match both labeled layers and ten artist coordinates. A cross-field BARY transform stays pending.

ms-baseline-columns.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs vector baseline averaging at each integration for one or two stored MeasurementSet visibility ordinates.
ms-baseline-columns.result: Twelve paired text exports match 156 selected coordinates and metadata. The cases check the first selected correlation weight, the positive weight floor, cube and row flags, ignored spectra, synthetic antenna fields, vector cancellation and separate overlapping observations in iterator order. A 500 by 360 pixel PNG matches both labeled layers and 12 artist coordinates.

ms-baseline-channel-columns.kind: Same-input MeasurementSet channel and baseline visibility averages
ms-baseline-channel-columns.scope: Public CASA 6.7.6.14 / casaplotms 2.9.1 and casa-rs vector channel and baseline averaging at each integration for one or two stored MeasurementSet visibility ordinates.
ms-baseline-channel-columns.result: Twelve paired text exports match 258 selected coordinates and metadata. The cases check separate channel spectra, row-weight and row-sigma fallbacks, model-only weights, flags, selected bins, frequencies, synthetic antenna fields, vector cancellation, a fully flagged first correlation and partly defined spectra under reversed physical order. A 500 by 360 pixel PNG matches both labeled layers and 24 artist coordinates.
